title: Billing Efficiency lines, labor rate on hover, and no extra lines
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an owner/admin (or any user with the Reports permission) on the build under test; a single workplace is selected.
  2. The Billing Efficiency chart expanded with several advisors, and the technician charts expanded.
custom_steps:
1. Confirm the Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.
2. Hover a point and confirm the tooltip shows that advisor's billing efficiency percent and ELR dollar amount, and that ELR is not drawn as its own line or axis.
3. Confirm each chart draws only the lines its story defines (one per selected technician, or one per advisor) with no shop-average, aggregate or other reference line.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.
  • Hovering a point on the Billing Efficiency chart shows a tooltip with that advisor's billing efficiency percent and ELR dollar amount.
  • The Billing Efficiency chart does not draw ELR as its own line or axis.
  • A chart draws only the lines its story defines (one per selected technician, or one per advisor) — no shop-average, aggregate or other reference line.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-490, story SV-9581 (S9 — Chart Behavior); Dashboard v1 specification, Confluence page 788430850, section S9; read on 2 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S9-R4: “The Billing Efficiency chart draws one billing-efficiency line per advisor.”
  • S9-R5: “When the user hovers a point on the Billing Efficiency chart, the tooltip shows that advisor's billing efficiency percent and that advisor's ELR dollar amount.”
  • S9-R6: “The Billing Efficiency chart does not draw ELR as its own line or axis.”
  • S9-R7: “A chart draws only the lines its own story defines: one line per selected technician on the technician charts, and one line per advisor on the Billing Efficiency chart (S9-R4). It draws no shop-average line, no aggregate line and no other reference line behind or alongside them. Any additional drawn series is a defect.”

Last checked against build v26.39.1-09be696 on 10/2/2026.
